dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans using VA facilities, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and non-federal entities wishing to donate property or fund projects.
dimensions.evidence: the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) may accept donations of property or facilities from certain nonfederal entities

dimensions.assessment: Enables non-federal entities to fund and donate minor construction and maintenance projects to the VA on an ongoing basis without statutory caps.
dimensions.evidence: A minor construction, or nonrecurring maintenance, project of the Department.

dimensions.assessment: Accepts private or non-federal property and facility donations for VA projects, potentially altering capital improvement outlays without stating aggregate dollar limits.
Amends title 38 of the United States Code to make a temporary pilot program permanent, expand allowable donation types, and remove numerical caps.
dimensions.evidence: This Act makes permanent... the pilot program under which the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) may accept donations of property or facilities

dimensions.assessment: Makes the program permanent and extends underlying sunset parameters from December 16, 2026, to December 16, 2031.
dimensions.evidence: This Act makes permanent... the pilot program... by striking `December 16, 2026` and inserting `December 16, 2031`.

missing_information: Total monetary value of expected donations or specific locations where minor construction and maintenance projects will take place.
importance_detail.rationale: Permanently extends and expands an existing VA pilot program allowing acceptance of donated property, facilities, and minor construction or maintenance projects from non-federal entities, while removing limits on the number of accepted donations.
